summary: Full E2E of Skin Crafting (Phase 1): demo auth token + localStorage flow, /crafteo 3-column layout, materials-bar chips, recipe cards, category tabs (all/carnivore/herbivore/owned/craftable), recipe detail panel with requisites, CRAFT with atomic deduction (bones 390->350, metal 330->310), queue-job appearance, sped-up (crafting_speed_mult=3600) completion, CLAIM via queue button, success toast ('Stego Invernal añadida a tu colección.'), job removed from queue, recipe status flipped to OWNED. Admin /admin > Crafteo tab works with all sub-tabs (materials/recipes/settings/grant/logs). Settings save returned 'Ajustes guardados y propagados'. Responsive verified at 1920x1080 and 390x844 (no horizontal overflow, columns stack). All prior backend anti-exploit checks (idempotency, not-ready-claim 400, double-claim 409) previously curl-verified by main agent; not re-run this iteration.

player_flow.claim_toast: Stego Invernal añadida a tu colección.

admin_flow.settings_ws_propagation: verified via toast + prior /crafteo speed=3600 taking effect

critical_code_review_comments: CraftingContext refresh() is invoked on nearly every WS event (started/completed/claimed/cancelled/recipe:updated/material:updated/settings:updated). Server-authoritative state is fine, but consider merging deltas server-side for higher-scale to avoid GET /state amplification when many players are notified simultaneously.

materials:updated event only updates inventory (setState uses msg.data.inventory), but recipe.status/materials.ok flags are derived server-side and won't refresh from that event alone. Not observed as a bug here because craft/claim also trigger refresh(), but granting materials from admin will only update chip numbers, not recipe requirement check marks, until another event fires.
seed_data_creation: Granted 300 of each material (bones/metal/leather/polymer) to demo user; set crafting_speed_mult=3600.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Skin Crafting Phase 1 is fully working E2E. To retest quickly: POST /api/auth/demo, PUT /api/crafting/admin/settings {crafting_speed_mult:3600}, POST /api/crafting/admin/grant for the 4 materials, then navigate /crafteo. crafting_speed_mult should be reset to 1 if timing-sensitive UX (progress bar animation) needs verification.
